description: Use this when the user asks why their emails go to spam or wants a full deliverability check of a domain. Runs SPF, DKIM (finds the selector on its own), DMARC, blacklist and MX checks in one call and returns pass, warning or fail for each, an overall result, and the fixes to apply in priority order with help links. Takes about 10 seconds. mailX never changes DNS.

dkim_selector.description: The DKIM selector, e.g. google (Google Workspace), selector1 or selector2 (Microsoft 365). Optional: omit it to try common selectors.

domain_name.description: The domain to audit, e.g. example.com
